state:Andhra Pradesh.text: Andhra Pradesh has aggressively pursued artificial intelligence development, positioning Visakhapatnam and Amaravati as major hubs through multi-billion-dollar investments for hyperscale AI data centres by tech giants like Google and Reliance [R42588509, R1349768b, R3ae0270b]. The state cabinet has established formal policy frameworks, including a dedicated Robotics and Physical AI Policy and approvals for specialized frontier technology universities and digital infrastructure [R78ad8544, Rf466bb64]. Furthermore, the government has integrated AI across various public sectors by deploying automated tools for healthcare services, tax administration, agricultural and urban management, and comprehensive educational skilling programs [R6e71a6d9, R1e515ffc, Rb7d37144, Ra4163b0a].

state:Bihar.text: Bihar has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through strategic partnerships with major technology firms like Google, Microsoft, and Singapore-based GFTN, alongside hosting prominent events such as the India AI Impact Summit [R44971ae6, Reb7bfdb3, R6fdc0aaa, Rd71e810d]. The state cabinet approved the establishment of the Bihar Artificial Intelligence Mission and various initiatives focusing on youth training, digital education in schools, and administrative reforms [R6fdc0aaa, Re18a3100, R57e2c2ec]. Additionally, artificial intelligence applications are being integrated across diverse governance sectors, including healthcare, law enforcement, land revenue, and public service delivery [Ra3ee576b, Rd023f017, Rac954476, R5f4d5428].

state:Gujarat.text: The Government of Gujarat has actively advanced artificial intelligence through infrastructure development, targeted governance applications, and educational initiatives. Key infrastructure efforts include the establishment of AI and data center clusters near GIFT City [Rb322fa47, R42b5efe9], a statewide GPU-as-a-Service framework [Rd1b68bba], and the Data Centre Policy 2026-29 aiming for Green AI capacity and mandatory renewable power integration [Re041bd74, R0d737a25, R43f4ae2b]. State governance is leveraging AI across sectors such as agricultural paddy quality testing [Re71562c3], dairy farming guidance via the Amul AI platform [Ra310e3fc], police surveillance challenges [R28ccc09b], and student dropout prevention [R88fee491]. Additionally, the state has initiated a major student training mission targeting 5 lakh students and thousands of faculty members [Ra6932da2], while the Gujarat High Court has concurrently enacted policies prohibiting AI use in judicial decision-making and judgment drafting [Rbd9766bd].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has pursued extensive AI integration across governance, infrastructure, and education, highlighted by initiatives like establishing AI Centres of Excellence, proposing an AI university, and planning the Greater Bengaluru Integrated Township [Re78dfed2, Rc16dddf8, R2c8e9508]. The state administration has leveraged public-private partnerships and international collaborations with entities like Anthropic and ElevenLabs to advance voice AI, open government datasets, and improve public service delivery [R65d60606, Rff273deb]. Educational reforms feature prominently, including introducing AI as a vocational subject starting from Class 6 and Class 9 in government schools, alongside targeted skilling and teacher training programs [R8176ca19, R3e7508f6, R044b5fa1]. Furthermore, administrative processes have adopted artificial intelligence for workforce attendance, crop surveys, and construction monitoring [Rf518fff6, R9d27904f, R1babb5c5].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through comprehensive policy approvals, significant infrastructure investments, and targeted governance frameworks [R562864e1, R03b6b6d6]. The state cabinet approved an AI policy backed by a ₹10,000 crore investment plan and established dedicated oversight committees and a new IT-AI department [R562864e1, Rd7d40f74, R5afedf9c]. Key initiatives span multiple sectors, including the deployment of 'Maha AI' for governance, Sarvam AI tools for government operations, and partnerships with technology firms for green data centres and AI innovation hubs [R68fee1a0, Re0b416d1, R03b6b6d6]. Additionally, the state has integrated AI into public services, policing, education, and agriculture through specialized platforms and pilot projects [R04592b70, R44b25a30, Rcd594eaf].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha is actively integrating artificial intelligence into public administration, governance systems, and citizen service delivery, highlighted by the expansion of the "Ama Sathi" WhatsApp chatbot and AI-enabled infrastructure contracts [Rabdf8555, Rd731fc75, R2439bfe6]. The state is driving major technological and industrial investments, including approvals for large-scale AI data centres, semiconductor packaging, and sovereign compute projects with partners like HCLTech, Adani Group, and Sarvam AI [R31b27cb7, R78b0f274, R230b6e3b]. Furthermore, Odisha is scaling up AI education and workforce training by incorporating artificial intelligence into school labs, higher education curricula, and vocational programmes [Rdb5da3c5, R47f5da8c, R7b9bb8d3].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued widespread integration of artificial intelligence across education, governance, agriculture, and law enforcement. The state education system introduced AI as a core and mainstream curriculum subject in government schools for classes ranging from Class I to XII [Rf6319e99, Re45fa955, R5c2eec42]. Concurrently, law enforcement agencies deployed AI-powered tools, voice recognition systems, and smart command centers in partnership with IIT Ropar to track criminals and dismantle organized crime [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77, Re289fcd5]. State initiatives also leveraged AI for agricultural advisory services, healthcare screening, and infrastructure monitoring [R609b6fc5, Ree614b14, R4e4970c3].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has advanced extensive artificial intelligence initiatives spanning digital governance, public infrastructure, and wildlife conservation. The state government has launched AI-powered citizen service platforms like the 'Namma Arasu' and 'NalamAI' WhatsApp chatbots, alongside deploying AI warning systems on railway tracks to prevent elephant deaths [R576baa19, R494484b4, R31409be3]. Furthermore, Tamil Nadu inaugurated an AI-ready data center campus in Siruseri and partnered with IIT Madras to create an AI Data Centre and state-owned GPU cluster [R70cb396d, R305828a2, R8b2c535d]. Educational and workforce readiness has also been emphasized through targeted teacher training programs, AI app exposure for school students, and new trades in industrial training institutes [R9cd35018, Rfe24cede, R5742a9b1].

state:Telangana.text: The Telangana government has actively advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across infrastructure, governance, and public services, establishing key hubs like the AI City and the Telangana AI Innovation Hub [R3d56ec33, Rafe9a4a2]. Major technology investments include multiple large-scale AI data center clusters and partnerships with firms like Microsoft for applied AI and green skills centres [R998e03d5, Rc056fe14, Rd164dad2]. State agencies have integrated AI into policing, transport licensing, revenue collection, and agricultural market yards to enhance operational efficiency [Ra1409382, R849548ed, R45e372bd, R2fafc184]. Additionally, the administration has launched extensive AI literacy and skilling programs targeting millions of students and youth across the state [R6843cc3b, R89c590e8].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure projects, governance applications, and workforce skilling initiatives. The state has approved the establishment of an AI city in Lucknow and a robotics and AI park in Greater Noida, alongside securing multi-billion-dollar investments for AI data center hubs [R3cf60d9f, Rb1cbd4df, Rad45bc42]. Governance and public service delivery have been enhanced through AI-driven projects spanning road safety, crime investigation apps like YAKSH, and health initiatives [Re48eb24d, Ra6233201, Rb205e61f]. Additionally, the state government has prioritized educational reforms and digital skills training, partnering with major tech firms to equip millions of youth with AI capabilities [R1e320eca, 10e7268a, Rc6148c8c].

category:strategy_policy.text: State governments across India have increasingly prioritized artificial intelligence through comprehensive policy approvals, dedicated funding, and infrastructure initiatives. States such as Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar have approved formal AI policies and missions supported by substantial capital investments and structured startup frameworks [R562864e1, R3cf60d9f, R6fdc0aaa]. Concurrently, several states are investing heavily in foundational digital infrastructure by launching data center policies, green AI data centers, and specialized IT-AI tech hubs [R3eefbde9, Re041bd74, R398131aa]. Regional administrations are also integrating AI into educational curricula, public service delivery, and administrative governance to drive regional innovation [R7cc53f61, R3db21292, R8f4114ad].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and high courts have actively established regulatory frameworks and restrictions concerning the deployment of artificial intelligence in judicial and administrative processes. Notably, the Gujarat and the Punjab and Haryana High Courts implemented policies prohibiting the use of AI tools in decision-making, judgment drafting, or issuing legal notices, following instances involving AI-generated non-existent case laws [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30, R8eacd504, R3d477cff]. States have also focused on safeguarding data privacy and mitigating risks associated with deepfakes and synthetic content through departmental circulars and advisory measures [R607d069a, Rc7b7e0d9, Re078b4dc]. Additionally, several states are formulating comprehensive responsible AI policies, safety protocols, and frameworks for data governance to oversee ethical adoption [R9b3c768e, Raf4f7b8d, Rdff5f567]. Committees and panels were further established to draft standard operating procedures for emerging technologies such as wearable AI devices and automated monitoring systems [Rba8badb1, R40c3cafc].

category:funding_budget.text: State governments across India have committed significant funding and budgets toward artificial intelligence missions, data infrastructure, and sector-specific applications. Major financial allocations include multi-crore state AI missions and data center investments in states like Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Bihar, and Maharashtra [R7cc53f61, R68fee1a0, Rb312992b, R297b1b1d]. States are also dedicating substantial capital to specialized projects in agriculture, environmental monitoring, and skill development through targeted policy frameworks and public-private partnerships [Re1ef3be9, Radc0ac36, R5c8784f8, R311c8976].

category:infrastructure.text: Indian state governments have heavily focused on expanding AI infrastructure through major investments in gigawatt-scale data centres, AI cities, and specialized technology parks [R5b4a7a80, R42588509, R1b6cbab3]. Prominent partnerships with industry giants like Google, Microsoft, and Reliance have driven substantial capital commitments for hyperscale facilities and green data centres across states like Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and Telangana [R42588509, R1349768b, Rf8ceda95, R398131aa]. Additionally, states are actively establishing Centres of Excellence, GPU-as-a-service frameworks, and dedicated universities to support advanced AI research and local compute capabilities [Rd1b68bba, R998e03d5, Re0b416d1].

category:partnership.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued partnerships and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with technology companies, academic institutions, and global firms to bolster their artificial intelligence ecosystems [R44971ae6, R65d2a417]. These collaborations extensively target large-scale digital infrastructure development, such as the establishment of multi-gigawatt AI data centers, specialized compute hubs, and innovation parks in states like Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Telangana [R5b4a7a80, R42588509, Reff5d158, Re0b416d1]. Furthermore, numerous states have prioritized education, workforce skilling, and governance enhancement by partnering with entities like Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic to train teachers, students, and youth in artificial intelligence capabilities [Reb7bfdb3, R65d60606, R2889d124, R3bfd0d73]. Additional targeted agreements focus on specific public services, including multilingual technology expansion, agricultural solutions, and healthcare improvements through AI integration [Rd868781, R6de84b70, Rf88612cd].

category:deployment.text: State governments have heavily deployed artificial intelligence across public services, governance, and infrastructure, with several initiatives focused on healthcare, education, and transport. Notable projects include WhatsApp chatbots for public service delivery in Odisha and Tamil Nadu [Rabdf8555, R576baa19], AI-powered tools for law enforcement and cybercrime investigations in Maharashtra and Punjab [R04592b70, R7333c0ad], and automated monitoring systems for exams and traffic in Uttar Pradesh and Sikkim [Re0c4ff32, Re7e20a6f]. Additionally, states like Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh have integrated AI into agriculture, tourism, revenue administration, and road safety [Rccf3ba89, R6e71a6d9, Re48eb24d].

category:skilling.text: Indian state governments have launched extensive AI skilling and educational initiatives, introducing curricula and teacher training programs across schools and higher education institutions. Notable actions include Punjab making AI a mainstream subject for Classes 1 to 12 [Rf6319e99], Karnataka introducing AI from Class 6 alongside plans for a public AI university [R8176ca19, Rb77b1a7f], and various states partnering with major tech firms like Google and Microsoft to train teachers and youth [Reb7bfdb3, R1b5b6306, R06697b72]. States such as Uttar Pradesh and Bihar have established dedicated AI missions and large-scale training schemes targeting millions of youth [Rb312992b, R1a841461, Rb70e845b]. Additionally, regional programs focus on specialized demographics, including AI bootcamps for rural and tribal youth in Jharkhand and AI-enabled learning for tribal students in Chhattisgarh [R19745493, R8ae280e0].

category:events_outreach.text: State governments across India have actively pursued AI outreach and capacity building through summits, conclaves, and hackathons focused on technology, governance, and skill development [R0a523d7f, R3fff65a8, R28ccc09b]. Major events such as the India AI Impact Summit, Bengaluru Tech Summit, and regional conferences in states like Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Odisha have served as platforms to showcase innovation, forge global partnerships, and launch strategic initiatives [R84a7e58c, R6abb0164, R4348031c]. Additionally, numerous states have organized specialized workshops, boot camps, and training programs aimed at integrating AI into sectors like healthcare, policing, agriculture, and public administration [R12d4ab71, R28ccc09b, R24998453].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has integrated artificial intelligence across education, governance, transport, and public safety sectors, launching initiatives such as AI teacher tools, school robotics training, and teacher upskilling programs [R0689eb15, R3db21292, Rc3656b09]. The state has deployed extensive AI traffic camera networks and explored robotics for policing and public service delivery, though some surveillance projects faced public controversies and technical outages [R6d538903, R76f370e7, R86fefa39]. Furthermore, Kerala has pursued administrative overhauls, established twin AI Centres of Excellence, and attracted major technology and startup investments to position itself as an emerging AI hub [R8f4114ad, Rcaa18758, Ra525c46d].

category:governance_body.text: Several Indian state governments have established specialized governance bodies, ministries, and task forces to institutionalize artificial intelligence in public administration and policy execution [R2dd69e13, R301d6af1, Re88286cf]. Pioneering steps include Kerala and Tamil Nadu creating dedicated AI portfolios and ministries alongside broader technology department rebrandings [R6bbe2d82, Ref475c84, R6b87d519]. States like Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat, and Bihar have constituted dedicated policy task forces, ethical committees, and district-level cells to oversee AI integration, data analytics, and administrative reforms [R9b3c768e, Ra3ee576b, R301d6af1, Rfb71877d]. Additionally, police departments in states such as Haryana, West Bengal, and Telangana have moved to form specialized AI units and task forces to combat cyber threats and enhance policing [Ra6b5d331, Re268e526, Ra1409382].

overall.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued artificial intelligence initiatives across infrastructure, governance, and education since late 2022. States like Maharashtra, Bihar, Rajasthan, and Chhattisgarh have approved comprehensive AI policies or missions backed by substantial multi-crore investments [R4af400f2, R6a6bee70, R7cc53f61, R562864e1]. Infrastructure developments feature major data center projects and AI cities planned or underway in regions such as Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, R5b4a7a80, R42588509]. Furthermore, numerous states are integrating AI into public administration, law enforcement, and school curricula for early student training [Rf6319e99, Rd731fc75, R8176ca19, R04592b70].

state:Assam.text: Assam has actively pursued an AI-driven transformation across governance, education, healthcare, and infrastructure, mapping hundreds of proposals and commissioning a government-owned GPU cluster to power state services [R936eb0aa, R416e5d33]. Key initiatives include deploying artificial intelligence for flood rescue via WhatsApp, forest encroachment and deforestation monitoring, and wildlife protection through automated train collision alerts and monitoring systems [Rc2490b65, R9c52da90, R037e76ac, Rddd6a227, R692a244d]. The state has also integrated AI tools into schools and teacher training programs in partnership with Google and UNICEF, alongside introducing AI anchors and administrative systems like 'ALISA' [R5a187c0b, R39b50ddb, Re167bad2, R68e89c81].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives through its Rs 500 crore Chief Minister AI Mission, targeting governance, digital infrastructure, and skill development [R7cc53f61, R63bfb6f9]. Key infrastructure projects include laying foundations for an AI data center park in Nava Raipur and attracting major investments such as a Rs 41,750 crore data center commitment from Singapore's Energy Capital Global [Rcc6c8e84, R28218dab]. The state has also implemented AI applications across various sectors, including wildlife conservation, education campaigns partnering with Google, and law enforcement operations [R398fad0d, R8958cba0, R1dec6260].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, law enforcement, education, and agriculture, supported by partnerships with organizations like the World Bank [R08e27cff, R56704031]. Major infrastructure plans include establishing AI hubs in Gurugram and Panchkula, an AI data centre, and an AI sandbox for public service pilots [Ra92a52de, R03b25e4d, R4b3be64a]. Law enforcement and governance have integrated AI for cybercrime tracking, financial fraud monitoring, and automated surveillance [R00f487ea, R770d942f, Rdb9464b3], while education and training initiatives introduce AI labs and skill programmes in schools and industrial training institutes [R1cd067ec, R01ac3f97]. Furthermore, the state applies AI to agriculture and healthcare through digital soil mapping, disease screening, and weather intelligence tools [Rf90e65a4, Rb4ae5aa0, R8677362d].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh has actively integrated artificial intelligence across education, governance, and public services, including the launch of digital learning tools like the 'Padhai with AI' app in Bilaspur and the incorporation of AI curricula in schools [Rb23a865a, Rbc10366f]. The state government has advanced AI-driven administrative systems, such as document verification on the Him Seva Portal and meeting management platforms, alongside healthcare initiatives like robotic-assisted surgeries and AI fraud-detection in the Himcare scheme [R38e56e62, R1ba6a5ba, Rc3a3d3b4, Reb98bbcd]. Furthermore, institutional collaborations with bodies like IIT Mandi have driven projects in forest intelligence, ecological restoration, disaster resilience, and deepfake detection [Rd81af6f6, Re6fc0429, R26835c79, Rc06b19cc].

state:Jharkhand.text: The government of Jharkhand has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across multiple sectors, anchored by the draft Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 and the Vision 2050 roadmap aimed at driving investments, governance, and job creation [R7694c76a, R927ec078]. Major developments include infrastructure projects like a data centre and AI tools for the High Court, mandatory AI use for quality control in infrastructure, and specialized AI monitoring tools for public safety, healthcare tracking, and wildlife management [Re675872a, Rde702427, Rb7cd9ee5, Rd53d5e43]. Additionally, the state is expanding educational and training programs through new AI labs, school smart classes, and centers of excellence to build a skilled workforce [R8022329a, R95bbe8d6, R86310780].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh has increasingly integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public safety, infrastructure, and healthcare initiatives [R6473839f, Rde25e470, R085470af]. Notable measures include AI-driven systems for monitoring civic purchases and financial transparency, as well as enhanced surveillance and resource management for events like Simhastha 2028 [R12d4ab71, R4c96f220]. The state is also advancing major technology infrastructure projects, including investments in data centers, semiconductor chip fabrication, and proposed AI city developments [Rac12a0cd, Rd5bd5d63, R3380db4b].

state:Manipur.text: Manipur has integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, legal proceedings, and conservation efforts since late 2022. Significant actions include the Manipur High Court using ChatGPT for legal research and delivering a landmark verdict [Rc647f8ab, R647a600d, Rdb89b488], and partnerships with Microsoft and the BHASHINI Division to advance multilingual AI and digital governance [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. The state has also promoted AI in classrooms and academic research, launched an AI career guidance hub, and explored AI applications for wildlife trafficking and tribal development [Rbb7d36a7, R7249ca9d, Re9f95033, R13590541]. Additionally, initiatives span digital tourism, journalism workshops, and language translation tools like the app 'Ishaan' [R49d826c3, R3413274d, R0ffcf77b].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya has actively integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, public health, environmental management, and education. Significant actions involve drafting a new IT policy focused on AI, proposing a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence, signing an MoU with Wadhwani AI for agriculture and education, and deploying AI solutions for lake cleaning and school learning pilots [R9625f972, Rf277c3a3, Rf1f88f85, Rac5495f0, R24be49c9]. Additionally, the state has hosted regional AI conferences, showcased GeoAI-powered education governance models, and utilized data-driven systems to improve public health metrics and disaster mapping [Rd7994ab1, R73c7e0d9, R84a1eeb7, Rfbdf90e5].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has positioned itself as an active participant in artificial intelligence adoption, initiating a state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a regional technology ecosystem [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state government has integrated AI across multiple sectors, including deploying AI tools for tax enforcement, agricultural missions, police traffic management, and healthcare infrastructure [Ra65da593, R2235629e, R8edb04a8, R2748f23d]. Additionally, Tripura has focused heavily on education and digital inclusion by launching AI skill initiatives, free courses for students, and translation services via the BHASHINI initiative [R3fff65a8, R12023632, R2f53bb22].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through high-profile events such as the Uttarakhand AI Impact Summit and the Devbhoomi AI Summit to position the state as a hub for responsible technology and governance [R2d4fffde, R8a719696]. The government has integrated AI into public administration, leveraging machine learning and computer vision to curb tax evasion, monitor illegal mining, automate cyber fraud helpline responses, and secure the uniform civil code portal [Recb1f69d, R549f779d, Rd3b15ea6, Rc3235cc0]. In the environmental and wildlife sectors, the state employs AI-powered cameras, acoustic surveillance systems, and intrusion detection tools to mitigate human-wildlife conflicts and manage forests [R994e0e10, R82962675, Rf32d6d42]. Furthermore, educational integration features prominently through AI literacy programs in schools, new engineering curricula, and university partnerships to train youth and educators [Rb0eb9126, R42cd5368, Rcea6d545]. ecosystem.

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively advancing artificial intelligence integration across industrial, administrative, and educational sectors, anchored by a draft industrial policy and the West Bengal AI Mission focusing on infrastructure, data centres, and MSMEs [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R90ad9af5]. Governance and public safety initiatives include the formation of a dedicated West Bengal Police AI Cell, an MoU with Rashtriya Raksha University for AI surveillance training, and the deployment of AI-powered applications for investigations, missing persons, and civic service management [Re268e526, R5118fef0, R08e415eb, Rebcdd9ec, R1e4db06d]. Educational reforms feature the introduction of AI, data science, and coding curricula across schools and higher secondary boards, alongside training partnerships with Oracle to upskill thousands of students [Rf61a82a3, Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1, R6da26467, R0c4d9eef].

state:Rajasthan.text: Rajasthan has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through institutional policies, including the approval of the AI-ML Policy 2026 and public sector capacity building via free foundational courses [R6a6bee70, R2c694631]. The state government and various institutions have integrated AI applications across sectors such as agriculture partnerships with Wadhwani AI, healthcare diagnostics, wildlife conservation monitoring, and automated public grievance redressal [R6de84b70, R13383be3, R311c8976, Rcaf01e51]. Additionally, AI technologies are being deployed for public safety and governance through smart traffic systems, facial recognition, and automated policing frameworks [Rd7e6b721, Re3a38ffb, R0af96cb6].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland has actively advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, agriculture, and public services, highlighted by the launch of an AI-powered digital agriculture ecosystem and the Eliona AI Supercomputer for disaster preparedness [Ra8c17a13, R3a286812]. The state has also integrated AI into law enforcement and local administration, deploying number plate reading cameras for the police and winning a National e-Governance award for a district WhatsApp chatbot [R17676278, Rb26a6b87]. Education and skilling are major focal points, featuring the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence, faculty development workshops, and plans to introduce an AI curriculum starting from Class 6 [R6f55ee54, Ree819f7b, R8b9ea930].

state:Sikkim.text: Sikkim has actively integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, most notably deploying an AI-driven Traffic Management System and e-challan mechanisms to enhance road safety and manage traffic congestion [Re7e20a6f, R24fc93a2, Ref56657c]. In education and agriculture, the state has launched AI-powered learning programs in government schools, partnered with NIELIT Gangtok to establish an AI Centre of Excellence, and pilot-tested an AI-enabled WhatsApp chatbot to support farmers [R27258895, Red4520ff, R2569fc2d]. Additionally, the government has advanced technology adoption by introducing an AI-based permit system to boost tourism and discussing AI applications for disaster prediction and higher education partnerships [Rfc6c0173, Rb685bb8f, R604d927c].
